Hi Anita / Datadog / Lucas —

Thanks again for the sync earlier. Following up with a concise implementation checklist we propose for the Visibility Program (aim: make Redwood telemetry visible in Datadog dashboards and Grafana bundles for early joint customers). The attached checklist is intentionally pragmatic — it prioritizes minimum required artifacts to certify a co-sell reference.

High-level ask: can your engineering or partner success contacts confirm feasibility on the items below and identify a single technical lead we can pair with for a short 4-week pilot?

Key checklist highlights (attachment has full details):
- OTLP endpoint compatibility matrix (ingest formats, compression, auth)
- Test dataset & replay harness (1.5M events/day envelope for throughput test)
- Dashboard templates and sample queries (Datadog monitors + Grafana dashboards)
- Joint SLA expectations for telemetry availability and retention for pilot accounts
- Commercial visibility: webinar slot + joint case study at pilot completion

Proposed timeline: kickoff next Tue (10/26), pilot window 10/26–11/23, certification review week of 11/29.

I've looped Ben and Laura for pricing/enablement items. Neha from integrations will own the test harness and compatibility validation.

Please reply with: 1) technical lead name + contact, 2) constraints on timeline, 3) a note about whether Datadog or Grafana requires any pre-certification artifacts (SOC2 evidence, legal MSA clauses).

Thanks —
Sergio
